highlights: Harvest by voice: saying the crop, then two plain numbers, then next (for example Suyo Long, 2, 165, next) now saves 2 count and 165 grams. Before, the second number replaced the first.
When the app guesses a unit, the saved line now says which one (for example 2 count assumed), and a third plain number is left out with a note instead of overwriting what you already said.
